description: This Java class 'PostingPeriod' models a period for interest posting in a savings account, including balance calculations, interest accrual, and compounding periods. It handles creation from transaction data, interest calculation, and period interval management within the interest calculation framework of the Fineract project.

classes.name: PostingPeriod
classes.description: Represents a savings account interest posting period, encapsulating balance, interest calculation, and compounding details, with methods for creation, interest calculation, and period management.

methods.name: createFrom
methods.description: Creates a PostingPeriod instance from transaction details, balances, and interest parameters, handling balance bounding and interest transfer logic.

methods.name: createFromDTO
methods.description: Creates a PostingPeriod instance from DTO transaction data, with optional overdraft consideration.

methods.name: interest
methods.description: Returns the interest earned in this period.

methods.name: dateOfPostingTransaction
methods.description: Returns the date when interest was posted.

methods.name: closingBalance
methods.description: Returns the closing balance for the period.

methods.name: openingBalance
methods.description: Returns the opening balance for the period.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest for the period based on compounding periods and interest rates.

methods.name: isInterestTransfered
methods.description: Indicates if interest has been transferred for this period.

methods.name: isUserPosting
methods.description: Indicates if the posting was made by a user.

methods.name: getFinancialYearBeginningMonth
methods.description: Returns the month the financial year begins.
